prior_year_events.impact_description: Series of catastrophe events in 2018 which were smaller in nature than those in 2017 and as a result were net retained by the Syndicate; contributed to deterioration on the 2018 year.
Wildfire events in California in 2018 materially impacted the 2018 year; net retained and contributed to adverse development.
Past 2017 events prompted correction in primary insurance pricing and influenced re-underwriting activity; referenced as legacy influence on prior years' development.

named_events.loss_description: Total losses from Covid-19 amount to GBP 66.5m. They are largely contained within our Contingency account and mainly relate to event cancellation cover.
Impacted 2018 year, smaller in nature than 2017 events and were net retained by the Syndicate.
Significant wildfires in California impacted 2018 results and led to remediation activity.

named_events.event_name: North Atlantic hurricane season (record US landfalls)
named_events.loss_description: Unusually active season with a record number of storms making US landfall; translated into a year characterised by frequency rather than severity of weather losses.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2020 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding opening position was GBP 798.7m. During 2020 there was an overall adverse prioryear development of GBP 6.8m driven principally by natural catastrophe activity and adverse claims development in a number of lines, with COVID19 event cancellation losses (c.GBP 66.5m) also noted as a material impact (largely within the Contingency account). The movement included deterioration in shorttail attritional and large losses in certain classes and continued remediations in marine and property-related portfolios.
raw_causal_phrases: Our total losses from Covid-19 amount to GBP 66.5m.
Losses from Natural Catastrophes had a material impact on our result, worsening the Combined Ratio by 11.2 percentage points.
In 2020, there has been an overall deterioration of GBP 6.8m (2019: improvement of GBP 36.3m).
This year was characterised by frequency rather than severity of weather losses.
The main impact has been seen through our Contingency book from event cancellation losses, the majority of these loss events falling to the 2019 year.
We also saw deterioration in attritional and large losses in a number of short tail lines.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (GBP 6.8m deterioration) is taken from the underwriting technical reserves narrative. The report contains a gross claims development triangle but the extracted table required careful alignment; a Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of 2017 & prior was effected post year-end which can distort development tables. Some LOB movement amounts were derived by yearend gross outstanding comparisons (2020 vs 2019) and therefore include current year effects; where triangle detail was ambiguous, the narrative figure was used. Gross vs net ambiguity in some narrative phrases means the prior_year_development figure is assigned moderate confidence.
